Rule.name: Exclude Disabled Accounts and Role-Justified Entitlements
Rule.Description:
Removes certifiable items for accounts that are currently disabled, and entitlements that are already granted indirectly through an assigned role (they get reviewed as part of the role certification instead).
Configure on Certifications > Certification Schedule > Advanced Settings. The rule contract is subtractive: return the items to REMOVE, never the full surviving list. Returning null or an empty list excludes nothing.
